从使用基于OCR的 `RapidTableModel` 改为使用VLM预测器。

## 详细修改

> 📌 涉及的修改：mineru/backend/pipeline/batch_analyze.py

### 1. 修改 BatchAnalyze 类的初始化

首先在 `BatchAnalyze` 类中添加VLM预测器支持：

```
<code>class BatchAnalyze:<br/>    def __init__(self, model_manager, batch_ratio: int, formula_enable, table_enable, enable_ocr_det_batch: bool = True, use_vlm_table: bool = False):<br/>        self.batch_ratio = batch_ratio<br/>        self.formula_enable = get_formula_enable(formula_enable)<br/>        self.table_enable = get_table_enable(table_enable)<br/>        self.model_manager = model_manager<br/>        self.enable_ocr_det_batch = enable_ocr_det_batch<br/>        self.use_vlm_table = use_vlm_table  # 新增VLM表格识别开关<br/>        <br/>        # 如果启用VLM表格识别，初始化VLM预测器<br/>        if self.use_vlm_table and self.table_enable:<br/>            from mineru.backend.vlm.vlm_analyze import ModelSingleton<br/>            self.vlm_model_singleton = ModelSingleton()<br/>            self.vlm_predictor = None  # 延迟初始化</code>
```

### 2. 添加VLM预测器获取方法

```
<code>def get_vlm_predictor(self):<br/>    """获取VLM预测器"""<br/>    if self.vlm_predictor is None:<br/>        self.vlm_predictor = self.vlm_model_singleton.get_model(<br/>            backend="transformers",<br/>            model_path=None,<br/>            server_url=None<br/>        )<br/>    return self.vlm_predictor<br/><br/>def image_to_base64(self, pil_image):<br/>    """将PIL图像转换为base64字符串"""<br/>    import base64<br/>    from io import BytesIO<br/>    <br/>    buffer = BytesIO()<br/>    pil_image.save(buffer, format='PNG')<br/>    img_bytes = buffer.getvalue()<br/>    return base64.b64encode(img_bytes).decode('utf-8')<br/><br/># <em>从VLM输出中提取表格HTML</em><br/>def extract_table_from_vlm_output(self, vlm_result,table_img):<br/>    <em>"""从VLM输出中提取表格HTML"""</em><br/><em>    </em>try:<br/>        # 解析VLM token输出，提取表格内容<br/>        from mineru.backend.vlm.vlm_magic_model import MagicModel<br/><br/>        # 假设vlm_result是token字符串，需要解析出表格部分<br/>        # 这里需要根据实际VLM输出格式进行调整<br/>        print('vlm_result', vlm_result)<br/>        magic_model = MagicModel(vlm_result, 1000, 1000)  # 使用标准化尺寸<br/>        table_blocks = magic_model.get_table_blocks()<br/>        print('table_blocks',table_blocks)<br/>        if table_blocks:<br/>            # 提取第一个表格块的内容并转换为HTML<br/>            table_block = table_blocks[0]<br/>            # 这里需要实现从VLM表格块到HTML的转换逻辑<br/>            # 具体实现取决于VLM输出的表格格式<br/>            return self.convert_vlm_table_to_html(table_block)<br/><br/>        return None<br/>    except Exception as e:<br/>        logger.warning(f"Failed to extract table from VLM output: {e}")<br/>        return None<br/><br/><br/># <em>将VLM表格块转换为HTML格式</em><br/>def convert_vlm_table_to_html(self, para_block):<br/>    <em>"""将VLM表格块转换为HTML格式"""</em><br/><em>    </em># 这里需要根据VLM表格块的具体格式实现转换逻辑<br/>    # 参考VLM后端的表格处理方式<br/>    try:<br/>        # 假设table_block包含表格的结构化信息<br/>        # 需要将其转换为HTML表格格式<br/>        html_content = "&lt;table&gt;"<br/><br/>        # 这里需要根据实际的table_block结构进行实现<br/>        # 示例代码，需要根据实际情况调整<br/>        from mineru.utils.enum_class import MakeMode, BlockType, ContentType<br/>        para_type = para_block['type']<br/>        if para_type == BlockType.TABLE:<br/>            for block in para_block['blocks']:  # 2nd.拼table_body<br/>                if block['type'] == BlockType.TABLE_BODY:<br/>                    for line in block['lines']:<br/>                        for span in line['spans']:<br/>                            if span['type'] == ContentType.TABLE:<br/>                                # if processed by table model<br/>                                if span.get('html', ''):<br/>                                    html_content += span.get('html', '')<br/>        html_content += "&lt;/table&gt;"<br/>        return html_content<br/>    except Exception as e:<br/>        logger.warning(f"Failed to convert VLM table to HTML: {e}")<br/>        return None</code>
```

### 3. 替换表格识别逻辑

表格识别代码替换为VLM：

```
<code># 表格识别 table recognition<br/>if self.table_enable:<br/>    if self.use_vlm_table:<br/>        # 使用VLM进行表格识别<br/>        vlm_predictor = self.get_vlm_predictor()<br/>        <br/>        for table_res_dict in tqdm(table_res_list_all_page, desc="VLM Table Predict"):<br/>            table_img = table_res_dict['table_img']<br/>            <br/>            try:<br/>                # 将表格图像转换为base64<br/>                table_base64 = self.image_to_base64(table_img)<br/>                <br/>                # 使用VLM预测<br/>                vlm_results = vlm_predictor.batch_predict(images=[table_base64])<br/>                <br/>                if vlm_results and len(vlm_results) &gt; 0:<br/>                    # 解析VLM输出中的表格内容<br/>                    html_code = self.extract_table_from_vlm_output(vlm_results[0],table_img)<br/>                    <br/>                    if html_code:<br/>                        expected_ending = html_code.strip().endswith('&lt;/html&gt;') or html_code.strip().endswith('&lt;/table&gt;')<br/>                        if expected_ending:<br/>                            table_res_dict['table_res']['html'] = html_code<br/>                        else:<br/>                            logger.warning('VLM table recognition processing fails, not found expected HTML table end')<br/>                    else:<br/>                        logger.warning('VLM table recognition processing fails, not get html return')<br/>                else:<br/>                    logger.warning('VLM table recognition processing fails, no results returned')<br/>                    <br/>            except Exception as e:<br/>                logger.error(f"VLM table recognition failed: {e}")<br/>                # 可以选择回退到OCR方式或跳过<br/>                continue<br/>    else:<br/>        # 原有的OCR表格识别逻辑<br/>        for table_res_dict in tqdm(table_res_list_all_page, desc="Table Predict"):<br/>            _lang = table_res_dict['lang']<br/>            table_model = atom_model_manager.get_atom_model(<br/>                atom_model_name='table',<br/>                lang=_lang,<br/>            )<br/>            html_code, table_cell_bboxes, logic_points, elapse = table_model.predict(table_res_dict['table_img'])<br/>            # 判断是否返回正常<br/>            if html_code:<br/>                expected_ending = html_code.strip().endswith('&lt;/html&gt;') or html_code.strip().endswith('&lt;/table&gt;')<br/>                if expected_ending:<br/>                    table_res_dict['table_res']['html'] = html_code<br/>                else:<br/>                    logger.warning(<br/>                        'table recognition processing fails, not found expected HTML table end'<br/>                    )<br/>            else:<br/>                logger.warning(<br/>                    'table recognition processing fails, not get html return'<br/>                )</code>
```
